source.title: HeYangTek HY SPI 2G datasheet v2.7, 2022-04-26 (HYF2GQ4UAACAE / HYF2GQ4UADCAE: MID C9, DID 52, 2K+128, 64 pages/block, 2048 blocks)

review.ecc_capability: 14 bits per 512 bytes; four sectors of 512 user + 8 meta + 24 ECC bytes, the first 4 meta bytes of each unprotected (no byte map of the spare area is given, so no OOB layout profile)
review.valid_blocks: at least 2008 of 2048; the first block guaranteed valid at shipment
review.family: the HY SPI 1G datasheet v2.3 (HYF1GQ4UDACAE, ID C9 21) agrees on the register map, the Read ID framing and the ECC status
review.kernel: firmware/kernels/v2.57.json, chips.hyf2gq4u: the stock driver admits ECCS 00b and 01b and refuses 10b and 11b (deal_ecc_status at 0x804f12f0).
